Messages.Author: Martin Ward
Messages.Body:
I looked in the recently posted Errata section but did not find a listing for
Entrancement. I have a Jyhad version and I want to know if the inferior
ability has errata to it. The text is "(D) Bleed at +1." Now, in the Inquest
that has a listing of card text for VTES it is "+1 stealth". Yes or no?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Inquest (whatever that is) is incorrect.
Both the Jyhad version and the V:tES version have a 0-stealth inferior bleed.
This is reflected in the official card list on WotC's page, as well:

Entrancement
Presence
Action
(D) Bleed with +1 bleed.
(M) (D) Take control of an ally controlled by another Methuselah. This is
a +1 stealth action.
Margaret Organ-Kean
Rare
